# Illustrating All Options — Gazoline Data {#sec-options}

**Data:** `gazoline_did_multiplegt_stat.dta` — 48 US states, 1966–2008.  
**Outcome:** `lngca` (log gasoline consumption). **Treatment:** `tau` (gasoline tax rate).

---

## I.01 — Multiple Polynomial Orders `or(1 2 3 4)` {#sec-i01}

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Stata

```stata
ssc install did_multiplegt_stat, replace
use "https://github.com/chaisemartinPackages/ApplicationData/raw/main/data_gazoline.dta", clear

did_multiplegt_stat lngca id year tau, or(1 2 3 4)
```

```
----------------------------------------------
                                   Number of observations     =             1632
                                   Estimation method          =    doubly-robust
                                   Polynomial order           =        (1 2 3 4)
                                  ----------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                               Average Slope (AS)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

             |  Estimate         SE      LB CI      UB CI  Switchers    Stayers 
-------------+------------------------------------------------------------------
          AS | -.0014429   .0026521   -.006641   .0037552        384       1248 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                           Weighted Average Slope (WAS)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

             |  Estimate         SE      LB CI      UB CI  Switchers    Stayers 
-------------+------------------------------------------------------------------
         WAS | -.0041614   .0010552  -.0062295  -.0020933        384       1248 
 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

### Python

```python
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import pandas as pd
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat

gazoline = pd.read_stata(
    "https://github.com/chaisemartinPackages/ApplicationData/raw/main/data_gazoline.dta"
)

m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["aoss","waoss"], order=[1,2,3,4], asinstata=True)
m.fit(gazoline, Y="lngca", ID="id", Time="year", D="tau")
m.summary()
```

```
-----------------------------------
N                =             1632
WAOSS Method     =    Doubly Robust
Polynomial Order =                1
-----------------------------------

----------------------------------------------------------------------
                    Estimation of AOSS(s)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
      Estimate         SE       LB CI      UB CI Switchers Stayers
AS  -0.0014429  0.0026521  -0.0066411  0.0037553       384   1,248

----------------------------------------------------------------------
                    Estimation of WAOSS(s)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
       Estimate         SE       LB CI       UB CI Switchers Stayers
WAS  -0.0041077  0.0010652  -0.0061955  -0.0020200       384   1,248
```

:::

### Python

```python
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import pandas as pd
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat

gazoline = pd.read_stata(
    "https://github.com/chaisemartinPackages/ApplicationData/raw/main/data_gazoline.dta"
)

m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["aoss","waoss"], order=1, controls=["lngpinc"],
                       placebo=3, aoss_vs_waoss=True, asinstata=True)
m.fit(gazoline, Y="lngca", ID="id", Time="year", D="tau")
m.summary()
```

```
-----------------------------------
N                =             1632
WAOSS Method     =    Doubly Robust

Controls         =          lngpinc
-----------------------------------

               Estimation of AOSS(s) - Placebo(s)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
             Estimate         SE       LB CI      UB CI Switchers Stayers

Placebo_2  -0.0010694  0.0031539  -0.0072510  0.0051122       200     759
Placebo_3  -0.0002238  0.0022821  -0.0046967  0.0042491       234     853

                    Estimation of WAOSS(s)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
       Estimate         SE       LB CI       UB CI Switchers Stayers
WAS  -0.0037564  0.0010187  -0.0057531  -0.0017598       384   1,248

----------------------------------------------------------------------
               Estimation of WAOSS(s) - Placebo(s)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
                   Estimate         SE       LB CI      UB CI Switchers Stayers
Placebo_1_waoss   0.0000586  0.0014493  -0.0027821  0.0028993       178     881
Placebo_2_waoss  -0.0005911  0.0009621  -0.0024768  0.0012945       200     759
Placebo_3_waoss  -0.0004444  0.0010838  -0.0025686  0.0016798       234     853

----------------------------------------------------------------------

H0: AOSS = WAOSS
      Estimate       SE     LB CI    UB CI  t stat.    pval.
Diff.  0.00237  0.01624  -0.00222  0.00697  1.01190  0.31159
```

## I.29–I.30 — Trimming and Cross-Fitting {#sec-i29}

```python
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import pandas as pd
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat

    "https://github.com/chaisemartinPackages/ApplicationData/raw/main/data_gazoline.dta"
)

# I.29 — reduced form
m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["aoss","waoss"], order=1, controls=["lngpinc"],
                       placebo=3, aoss_vs_waoss=True, trimming=10,
                       cross_fitting=2, asinstata=True)
m.fit(gazoline, Y="lngca", ID="id", Time="year", D="tau"); m.summary()

                       trimming=10, cross_fitting=2, asinstata=True)
m.fit(gazoline, Y="lngca", ID="id", Time="year", D="lngpinc", Z="tau"); m.summary()
```
